remarks: Beautiful, spacious and completely updated townhouse in private location, yet in the heart of New Canaan. Just 2-3 blocks to train, stores, restaurants, parks and more. This bright end unit with open floorplan has spacious rooms inside and an amazing large outdoor space. The Dining room area opens to the patio and fenced grassy area. There's even a vegetable garden. An inviting living room is bright with new wall of tall windows and a cozy Fireplace with build-ins. Updated kitchen includes stainless steel appliances, stone counters, newer cabinets and charming dining area with bay window. Upstairs, the primary suite has a dressing area with closets on each side, and a full bath with 2 vanities, separate shower and soaking tub. There are 2 additional, very generous sized bedrooms that share a hall bath. One of the bedrooms is used as an office and has a Murphy Bed. The hall bath will be completely renovated. Separate laundry room on 2nd floor has newer washer and dryer. No Pets per condo association and No Smoking. This is your dream townhouse!
